title: Wine Down Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in WaterColor's Lake District, Wine Down is a recently updated 2 bedroom beach house that sleeps 8. Custom Serena & Lily decor combined with an open living concept, sweeping porches, and beautiful updates!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *This home adheres to the Watercolor Rental Advertising Policies and Guidelines* *Maximum Certified Number of Guests for this home is 6* *Up to 6 wristbands are included to access Watercolor’s 5 pools, including the Beach Club pool and Camp Watercolor, as well as access to the private beach. The wristbands are issued to registered guests that are staying at the home,and strictly limited by the home’s Maximum Certified Number of Guests.* *This home has a private driveway and includes 2 Watercolor parking passes to use throughout Watercolor in designated locations* - Short walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - 6 Seater Golf included with a $1000 refundable security deposit and signed waiver (A $200/day savings!) - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Beautifully decorated with Serena and Lily decor - Gas grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Private beach with seasonal tram service - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Use of owner's golf cart with signed liability waiver and $1000 refundable security deposit. -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Located in WaterColor's Lake District, Wine Down is a recently updated 2 bedroom beach house that sleeps 8 comfortably. Custom Serena & Lily decor combined with an open floor plan, sweeping porches, and beautiful updates make this a favorite home for many repeat 30A vacationers. Nestled just off Western Lake and steps to downtown WaterColor, the newly renovated beach club, and the acclaimed Emerald Coast, Wine Down offers luxurious accommodations for the whole family. A sprawling front porch offers outdoor lounging space to kick back and relax. The main living and dining space offers ample seating, a sleeper sofa (sleeps 2), dining for 6 and an updated kitchen complete with stainless appliances and bar seating for 3 more. ACCOMMODATIONS: First floor: Bedroom 1: Master Suite- King bed, flat screen TV, private 2024 remodeled en-suite bathroom with dual sinks, and large shower. W/D is located in this bathroom. A private screened porch with sitting area is just off this bedroom. New 2024 addition added- small bunk closet (sleeps 2). 1/2 bath, kitchen, great room and dining area complete this level Second Floor: Bedroom 2: Two queen beds (sleeps up to 4), flat screen TV, and private en-suite with shower only ** No pets allowed ** Must be 25 to rent ** Golf cart included for those who pay the refundable deposit and sign the liability waiver. If the cart becomes unusable we will do our best to get it working for you. A replacement will not be available. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
